author: xBliitz
body: Hey guys as you guys know me, I was BlitzLikesPvP, but I was banned from avicus for saying "kys." How can I be perm-banned for that when I have never been given a warning/temp-ban? Please, take the time to unban me. I would appreciate it, as I stream Nebula on this server and I have been playing on it for around 1 1/2 years.
